Constructor wiring establishes x8 as initial and x4 as terminal. Activity is reversible; rollback reads next after destruction, and allocation and small-count hazards are accurately qualified without asserting destruction timing.

Unlike the active-only geometric helper, it_802C2DB0 applies gravity and position advancement to every previous link. The physics suffix is meaningful and resolves the observed rendered-name collision.
The corrected purpose preserves the index cutoff and distinguishes list exhaustion from the status-0 early return. State-2 registration is confirmed.
The caller supplies x8 and an attachment-derived anchor. Output-pointer wiring, boundary-helper invocation, unused Item argument and completion-driven state-0 transition match canonical source.
Only the initial scan tests current activity. Subsequent prev traversal writes translations and all nine scaled basis entries without changing ItemLink positions.
The transform-only purpose correctly retains the initial active-link precondition and avoids claiming per-link activity filtering in the main loop.

Construction retains the fighter attachment separately from the render joint. State-1 entry uses that attachment and initializes endpoint position, both collision samples, activity and callback as described.

Accepted deferral for the table's compiled-size and writable-section claim. Four initialized source rows are supported and retained; a 64-byte compiled object is not established by this evidence.

Accepted supersession of minimum-spacing and unconditional deployment-completion explanations. Proposals 0, 1 and 5 preserve target-reset ordering, the x/y anchor test, activation cutoff and early-return effects.

Accepted constructor corrections in proposals 2 and 3. Destruction-timing deferral remains appropriate: the registered destructor frees ItemLink storage, but no scheduling guarantee was established.

Accepted naming correction in proposal 4. Canonical gravity and advancement distinguish the colliding helpers independently of their rendered hypotheses; the unchanged geometric-helper name remains supported.
Accepted endpoint correction in proposal 6: retraction receives initial x8, not terminal x4, while retaining the supported completion and output flow.
Accepted both transform-traversal corrections in proposals 7 and 8. The initial activity scan has no null guard; the main loop processes every remaining prev link.
Accepted attachment-versus-render-joint correction in proposal 9 while retaining the supported state-entry behavior.

Accepted cross-file reference-lifetime deferral. EvtUnk can clear the cached fighter reference that both solvers dereference without a local null guard; the proposal and functionality document do not invent a scheduling guarantee.
